basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and RPG enthusiast from Seattle, Washington. I've been exploring the vast worlds of Elder Scrolls games for over 15 years, with Morrowind being a personal favorite due to its depth and immersive lore. Besides gaming, I'm a huge fan of Japanese culture, often indulging in anime and traditional music. As a web developer by profession, I work from home, which gives me flexible hours to engage in late-night gaming sessions and Reddit discussions. Single and living with my two cats, I enjoy the quiet life.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Self-taught in game mechanics and modding through years of playing and interacting with the gaming community. My expertise extends to programming, with a degree in Computer Science and a career in web development, which allows me to understand and contribute to technical threads.
